object_types.name: Reviewer
object_types.definition: A person who reviews papers for the conference.

source_references.excerpt: Reviewers review papers. A reviewer can review many papers, and each paper gets several reviewers
Reviewers have a reviewer ID.

object_types.name: Paper
object_types.definition: A paper submitted to the conference that is reviewed by reviewers.

source_references.excerpt: Reviewers review papers.
Papers have a paper number.

object_types.name: Review
object_types.definition: The objectified act of a particular reviewer reviewing a particular paper, tracked as its own entity with its own ID and score.

source_references.excerpt: each completed review gets its own review ID -- we treat the review itself as a thing we track.
The review is the act of a particular reviewer reviewing a particular paper -- the score hangs off that pairing, not off the paper alone.
Reviewers have a reviewer ID.
Papers have a paper number.
each completed review gets its own review ID

object_types.name: ReviewScore
object_types.definition: The overall rating given in a review, on a scale of 1 to 5.

source_references.excerpt: Every review has exactly one review score -- that is our term for the overall rating. The review score is always one of 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
